sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो गदां तस्मै चिक्षेप रजनीचरः।ज्वलन्तीं भास्कराभासां सुग्रीवाय महोदरः ।। ६.९८.२१ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddho gadāṁ tasmai cikṣepa rajanīcaraḥ।jvalantīṁ bhāskarābhāsāṁ sugrīvāya mahodaraḥ ।। 6.98.21 ।।

translations.english: Both the heroes, Mahodara and Sugriva like two bulls holding mace and iron bar respectively, like clouds charged with lightning came roaring in the battlefield.
